Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We value working with you and have looked at the whole package. Please find our proposals attached as term sheets - we are flexible on how we get there and would appreciate your best terms.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. 

Our current Angebot comprises a price of €31.60 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a Lieferzeit 56 days for a contract term of 24 months. The contract term is reflected in the price. 

Please note that this Angebot remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard procedures.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Regarding the ongoing negotiations with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

We offer a volume of 23400 pcs per year at a price of €31.60 per unit, with a Lieferzeit of 56 days and a contract term of 24 months. 

The contract term is reflected in the price. Without movement from your side we cannot move either. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. Our standard procedures apply.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

reasons: The contract term is reflected in the price.
Without movement from your side we cannot move either.
